title: 本文の裏の情報を調べる探検猫
usage: developer-privacyの導入と回遊。公開面を点検する架空の場面。
prompt: Generate a new illustration, reference image serves only as character and style reference. Same mature black explorer cat with tapered face, natural eyes, etched fine fur, orange backpack.
